image_description: A close-up portrait of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) facing forward. The dog has long, silky reddish-brown and white fur, with characteristic red patches on the ears and around the eyes, separated by a white blaze on the forehead. The nose is black and short, and the eyes are dark and round. The background is blurred, focusing attention on the dog's face.
